name: K1 Educational
summary: Education/research configuration of Booster Robotics' K1 humanoid platform: Jetson Orin NX 8GB compute (117 TOPS), a 5Ah battery giving ~80 min runtime at 0.4 m/s, and a 12-month manufacturer warranty with 24h technical support. Positioned for university programs and STEM curricula. Source: RobotShop EU listing, 2026-08-16.
specs_note: Entered by robert@humanoid.company from https://eu.robotshop.com/collections/booster-robotics (retrieved 2026-08-16). 10 field(s) not stated by the source and left UNKNOWN. ros_support and simulation_support are recorded TRUE per the source's own text ('compatible with the ROS2 communication protocol, with simulation support available for Isaac Sim') -- but the same page's 'Open Software Stack' section still qualifies this platform-wide: 'ROS 2 or Isaac-Sim support may require developer integration rather than being fully built in.' Treat both as SDK-level capability, not out-of-the-box support. AI compute (Jetson Orin NX 8GB, 117 TOPS) and warranty (12 months, 24h support) have no dedicated catalogue field and are recorded in `summary` instead. NOTE: source_url is RobotShop EU's Booster Robotics COLLECTION page, not the exact per-SKU product URL -- the precise product-page URL has been requested from the owner and should replace this citation once supplied.
